summary: Folders and files from a list of paths, opening folder by folder, with a picked row and the arrow keys.

props.name: paths
props.description: Every file by its path, `Documents/budget.xlsx`. Folders come from the paths; end one with `/` for an empty folder.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The folders open on first render, by path.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The row picked on first render, by path. Pair `selected` with `onSelectedChange` instead if you are controlling it.

props.name: selected
props.description: The controlled picked row, by path.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the path of the row just picked.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the tree and on each row.

props.name: animated
props.description: The chevron's turn and the folder's open and close. Turn it off for an instant tree, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
